_: The inner pages open.mjs --set inner presses (the inner-pages pass of PR #2479, 2026-11-12): items of the saved scale database's Gitea estate as the live Gitea on the WSL box holds it, one set per CPU throttle so each throttle's first open is a read knobas has never made. A path is a file of the repository's default branch; `deep` sits as far down as the repository goes (two directories, one in payments-gateway), `large` is the estate's largest file kind (about 30 KB), `binary` a PDF (the estate holds no image); `branch` is the branch with the most changes against main; `pr` and `prLarge` two open pull requests (in cart-service #124 has 8 files and 106 changed lines, #111 2 and 4; in payments-gateway #203 8 and 48, #211 7 and 64). `run` is a finished unit-test run of the TeamCity scale tree, read for its Log, Tests and Artifacts tabs.
